root.productName: Application display and bundle name; defaults to the Cargo package name.
root.$schema: JSON Schema URL used by editor validation.
root.app: Application identity, security, windows, native API, and assets.
root.build: Code generation, development package, web server, and debugging settings.
root.bundle: Resources included in the application package.

app.identifier: Application identifier, conventionally in reverse-domain form.
app.security: Content security policy and origin-scoped capabilities.
app.assets: Explicit mappings from request origins/paths to resource files.

build.mojomSources: Root-relative Mojom contract files for typed code generation.
build.devPackage: Directory of the refreshed native development package.
build.devUrl: Loopback frontend URL used by the authenticated dev override.
build.beforeDevCommand: Command started before the native development window.

bundle.resources: Application files and directories to include in the package.

security.capabilities: Native permissions for explicitly matched origins.

window.label: Application-visible window label.
window.url: Initial page URL for the native window.

javascript.filterPlaceholder: Filter exports, types, or member names…

rust.rustdocNote: Full signatures, trait implementations, and examples are available in the generated Rustdoc.
